message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends that occur in Canada during 2023**.  
(Only the federal holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday are shown; provincial‑only holidays that also create long weekends are noted where relevant.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Feb 18–20** | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | Monday, Feb 20 → long weekend (Sat 18–Sun 19–Mon 20). |
| **Apr 7–9** | **Good Friday** (all provinces) | Friday, Apr 7 → long weekend (Fri 7–Sat 8–Sun 9). |
| **May 20–22** | **Victoria Day** (all provinces) | Monday, May 22 → long weekend (Sat 20–Sun 21–Mon 22). |
| **Sep 2–4** | **Labour Day** (all provinces) | Monday, Sep 4 → long weekend (Sat 2–Sun 3–Mon 4). |
| **Oct 7–9** | **Thanksgiving** (all provinces) | Monday, Oct 9 → long weekend (Sat 7–Sun 8–Mon 9). |
| **Dec 23–25** | **Christmas Day** (all provinces) | Monday, Dec 25 → long weekend (Sat 23–Sun 24–Mon 25). |

### Quick‑look calendar view

```
2023 Long Weekends (Canada)

Feb 18–20  Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB, MB, PEI)
Apr 7–9   Good Friday (all provinces)
May 20–22 Victoria Day (all provinces)
Sep 2–4   Labour Day (all provinces)
Oct 7–9   Thanksgiving (all provinces)
Dec 23–25 Christmas Day (all provinces)
```

#### Things to keep in mind

* **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1, 2023) falls on a Sunday, so it does not create a long weekend unless a province gives the following Monday (Jan 2) off.
* **Canada Day** (Jul 1, 2023) falls on a Saturday; some provinces give the following Monday (Jul 3) off, but that is a provincial decision.
* **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11, 2023) is a federal holiday but falls on a Saturday, so it does not create a long weekend.
* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, 2023) is a federal holiday but falls on a Tuesday, so it does not create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app, and let me know if you’d like province‑specific long weekends or additional details!
